caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical metal lantern with a conical top and a large circular handle attached at the apex. The lantern's surface is rendered in grayscale with fine shading and stippling, giving the appearance of texture and metallic quality. The body of the lantern is covered in numerous small perforations arranged in radiating patterns, likely for ventilation and light diffusion. On two opposite sides of the cylinder, there are protruding, circular glass-like sections that could be lenses or windows. The lantern is vertically oriented on light tan or cream-colored paper, with the object centered and occupying most of the space. The hinge and clasp details on the front of the lantern are clearly visible, as is the subtle variation in surface brightness that suggests it is made of a reflective material. The corners of the paper are slightly darker, creating a gentle vignette around the drawing.
title: Lantern
